definitions.explanation: A visual representation created by drawing, painting, or other artistic means.
A picture in a book or document that explains or decorates the text.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}が{絵|え}を{描|か}いている。
examples.english: The child is drawing a picture.

examples.japanese: この{絵|え}は{有名|ゆうめい}な{画家|がか}の{作品|さくひん}です。
examples.english: This painting is a work by a famous artist.

notes:
{絵|え} is the everyday word for pictures and drawings.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {絵|え}を{描|か}く (to draw/paint a picture)
- {絵|え}を{見|み}る (to look at a picture)
- {絵|え}を{飾|かざ}る (to display a picture)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {絵本|えほん} (picture book)
- {絵|え}はがき (picture postcard)
- {油絵|あぶらえ} (oil painting)
- {水彩画|すいさいが} (watercolor painting)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {絵|え}: picture (casual, everyday)
- {絵画|かいが}: painting (formal, art context)
- {画|が}: painting (in compounds like {漫画|まんが}, {映画|えいが})
